name: clementina-sdk
description: Shared development SDK for the Clementina homebrew computer

scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run check:packages
scripts.test: node scripts/generate-schemas.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-runtime-sources.mjs --check && npm run validate:specs && npm run build && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
